about: core/loop_coverage.py (DEC-0101): every process MIA has, with a loop or a reason. status: todo (needs a loop), proposed (a task drafts it), none (why: no loop needed).

action:app.why: which apps show and which are favourites is their own choice; MIA judges nothing in it

action:camera.why: removing a camera they added is their own choice; the feed itself is a device, not a decision of hers

action:firstboot.why: once per device; the glasses first boot is watched through glasses.voice once it is done

action:profile.why: their own settings: nothing MIA chose, so nothing of hers to correct

action:setting.why: their own settings: nothing MIA chose, so nothing of hers to correct

check:birthday.why: a greeting once a year: there is nothing in how it lands to learn from

check:chronicle_issue.why: Zac approves every issue by hand, and its continuity rules are checked in code before he sees it

check:fix_report.why: it writes the fix report for Claude; the failures it lists are watched by answers.failures

check:rewards.why: it unlocks what the person already earned by rules they can see; it judges nothing of its own

check:seasons_of_memory.why: it keeps a summary of the history once a month; what it says is answered through the seasons plan, watched by the answers.* loops and calibration like every plan

check:self_report.why: it reports the loops: what it says is only as good as they are, and they are watched

store:gps_tracks.why: where a person went, from their own GPX files: no MIA behaviour in it to improve yet; its numbers are worked out in code and tested
